story.title: Made slowly, made with care
story.text1: I'm Jessy, and behind JessyIsCrafting there are hours of sanding, fine brushes and many cups of tea. Every piece is thought through, sketched and refined until I feel it truly deserves to leave my worktable.
story.text2: I'm not after mass production: I want you to open the box and feel that someone genuinely cared about what you're holding.

caballero.title: Henry the Knight
caballero.description: A hand-painted knight miniature, with every detail of the armour worked with a fine brush. Layers of colour build up slowly to give depth to the metal and the fabrics, without losing the character of a figure made to be seen up close.

minas-tirith.title: Oil «The Citadel»
minas-tirith.description: An oil on canvas showing a citadel rising between mountains, painted with thin glazes to capture the light of early morning. The composition leads the eye from the road up to the walls, where each stone is worked with short, precise brushstrokes.

farkle-detalle.title: Detail of the carved crest
farkle-detalle.description: A close-up of the crest hand-carved into a solid wooden box. The relief is shaped with gouges and gradual sanding; a finishing coat then sets the tone and brings out the natural grain of the wood.

luminoso.title: Luminous
luminoso.description: A digital illustration of an armoured figure and a white horse wrapped in mist. Light enters from an undefined point in the background and travels across the metallic surfaces, creating a soft contrast between shadows and reflections.

jinete.title: Heraldic rider
jinete.description: A diorama of a rider with a heraldic shield, mounted on a hand-painted base that recreates a dirt track. Each element of the shield is painted in solid colours with clean edges, so the crest reads clearly even from a distance.

heinrich.title: Heinrich's scene
heinrich.description: A narrative scene set in a medieval interior, digitally illustrated. The characters stand in a room lit by a single source of light, and every object in the hall tells a fragment of the story.

lune.title: Lune
lune.description: A figure on an effects base, painted with transitions of fire and crystal. The highlights are built in translucent layers, so the base looks like a fragment of another world for the character to stand on.

bosque.title: Corner of the forest
bosque.description: An oil on canvas of a stream running through a dense forest. The scene is built with layers of greens and ochres, letting the light filtering through the trees mark the path of the water.

renoir.title: Renoir
renoir.description: A collector figure in a long coat, finished in a matte coat to soften the reflections and bring out the fabrics. The paint is worked area by area, with particular care for the seams and folds.

mini-farkle.title: Travel Mini Farkle
mini-farkle.description: The compact version of the Farkle set, made to carry in a backpack. It keeps the same care for detail in a small format, ideal for trips, camping or an impromptu game always within reach.

commissions.title: Order your own illustration
commissions.p1: I draw original characters, fan art and digital portraits with a careful, narrative style. I can work from a description, visual references, or your own roleplay or video game character.
commissions.p2: Every commission includes an initial sketch to validate the pose and composition before moving on to colour, so we make sure the final result is exactly what you were looking for.

brands.title: Propose a collaboration
brands.p1: If you run a brand, a shop, an editorial project or a content channel and think we'd be a good fit, get in touch. I'm especially interested in collaborations related to crafts, medieval fantasy, video games and literature.
brands.p2: I can also prepare emote packs or illustrations for streamers and content creators, with revisions included until we nail the style that represents you best.

workshops.title: Introductory craft workshops
workshops.text: I'm open to organising or taking part in in-person or online workshops on miniature painting, digital drawing or woodcraft, whether for individuals, cultural spaces, shops or events. If you're interested, tell me about your idea.

inspiration.title: The worlds that shape my work
inspiration.subtitle: Everything I make comes from somewhere: an endless playthrough, a book you can't put down, a melody that stays with you for years. This is a bit of that origin.

kcd.title: The game that laid the foundations for all of this
kcd.p1: Kingdom Come: Deliverance is, probably, the reason JessyIsCrafting exists the way it does today. I discovered Bohemia, its forests, its mud, its sunset light filtering through the trees, and something clicked: I wanted to paint that, draw that, have those worlds sitting on my worktable.
kcd.quote: "A game that doesn't idealise the Middle Ages, but makes them feel real: dusty, hard, and at the same time, deeply beautiful."
kcd.p2: Its art direction — those weathered castles, those wooden villages, that palette of greens, ochres and stone greys — is behind much of my paintings and figures. And its soundtrack, with those choirs and medieval instruments, has played in the background of countless painting sessions.
kcd.p3: Henry, Hans Capon and all of Bohemia have found their way into my work in a thousand different forms: in a painted figure, in a digital sketch, in a scene I wanted to tell with my own hands.

reading.title: The other half of my brain
reading.p1: If I'm not painting, I'm probably reading, or writing. I've always loved filling in the gaps a story leaves untold: what a side character thinks, what happened between two scenes, what was felt in a moment the game barely touches.
reading.p2: That's where my Kingdom Come: Deliverance fanfics came from: a way of keeping on living in Bohemia a little longer, exploring its characters from another angle. If you'd like to take a look, I share them on Archive of Our Own.

item1.title: Worth the Wreckage
item1.summary: Henry leads a simple life, with the odd job that's better left unquestioned. When he's asked to take Hans into his home, no questions asked, two completely different worlds begin to clash — and, slowly, to change each other.

item2.title: Something We Cannot Name
item2.summary: What happened to Hans while he was held captive in Malešov, and what went through Henry's mind while he faced his most dangerous missions. The key events of KCD2 told from Hans's point of view, up to what happened in Suchdol.

item3.title: The Road to Constantinople
item3.summary: Hans Capon's wedding is drawing near. Before giving in to that fate, he fulfils a promise made to Henry years ago: to travel together all the way to Constantinople. One last journey of love and freedom, marked by the beauty of the world — and its cruelty.

contact.shippingText: I ship to Spain, the European Union and the United Kingdom without any issues. If you live elsewhere, please get in touch first so we can confirm timing and shipping costs — you'll find all the details in the FAQ.

faq.title: Everything you need to know before ordering
faq.subtitle: If you have a question that isn't answered here, feel free to reach out through the contact form.

shipping.q: Which countries do you ship to?
shipping.a: I ship as standard to all of Spain, the rest of the European Union and the United Kingdom. If you live anywhere else, message me before placing your order: we'll figure it out together, since customs fees and delivery times can vary quite a bit.

prepTime.q: How long does it take to prepare my order?
prepTime.a: Pieces that are already finished usually leave my workshop within 2-4 business days. Custom orders, illustration commissions or made-to-order painted figures normally need between 1 and 3 weeks, depending on how complex the order is and my waiting list at that moment. Around Christmas, I'd recommend booking well in advance.

returns.q: Can I return or exchange an order?
returns.a: Non-personalised catalogue pieces can be returned within 14 calendar days of receipt, as long as they arrive in perfect, unused condition. Personalised pieces, made-to-order commissions and illustration commissions cannot be returned, except in the case of a manufacturing fault or transport damage.

customization.a: It depends on each piece. On the Farkle sets you can choose initials, your own crest or the wood tone. On paintings, the canvas size and, in many cases, the scene itself. On digital drawings, the character or reference you'd like portrayed. And on figures, the colours, finish and base. Each product page lists exactly what can be adapted.

packaging.a: With a lot of care. Figures and paintings are protected with padded materials, and whenever possible I reuse or reduce plastic. If your piece is fragile, it's clearly marked on the parcel for whoever receives it on your behalf.

commission.q: How do I order an illustration commission?
commission.a: Message me through the contact form or on social media telling me your idea, with references if you have any. I'll prepare an initial sketch, we'll agree on the price and timeline together, and all that's left is moving on to colour. You'll find more information in the Customizations section.

payment.q: How is a commission paid for?
payment.a: Once the quote is agreed, I'll send you the payment details through whichever channel we're using for the order (bank transfer or the platform we're working on). For larger pieces or commissions, I usually ask for a deposit when the order is confirmed and the rest before shipping.

faq.ctaText: Get in touch and I'll be happy to help.

set-farkle-blason.name: Farkle Board
set-farkle-blason.short: Farkle board in a wooden box, hand-painted with your favourite crests.
set-farkle-blason.description: Farkle board in 20 cm x 20 cm box format, hand-painted and decorated with your favourite crests or motifs. Every detail, from the wood stain to the brushstrokes of the crest, is finished piece by piece.
set-farkle-blason.customization: You can choose the wood colours, the crests you want on each side up to 4 (two on the outside and two on the inside), or a custom motif such as letters or drawings.

set-farkle.name: Complete Farkle Set
set-farkle.short: Farkle board in a wooden box, hand-painted with your favourite crests.
set-farkle.description:
A Farkle board in 20 cm x 20 cm box format, hand-painted and decorated with your favourite crests or motifs. A set of 12 hand-engraved wooden dice and 4 special dice you can choose. Devil head, Hugo's Tooth... pick 4!
Two hand-stitched synthetic leather dice cups are included, so every roll comes out perfect.
And to complete the set, 50 wooden groschen, hand-painted one by one, to make the game even more fun.
set-farkle.customization: You can choose the wood colours, the crests you want on each side up to 4 (two on the outside and two on the inside), or a custom motif such as letters or drawings.

mini-farkle-viajero.name: Travel Mini Farkle
mini-farkle-viajero.short: A compact version of the Farkle set, ready to slip into a backpack or bag.
mini-farkle-viajero.description:
The same love for detail, in a small format made for travelling. Perfect for trips, camping, or simply having an impromptu game always within reach.
- Board of 12 cm x 12 cm.
- Includes 12 regular dice and 4 special ones, all hand-engraved. I always include 4 “devil heads”, but you can request another design.
mini-farkle-viajero.customization: You can choose the wood colours, the crests you want on each side up to 4 (two on the outside and two on the inside), or a custom motif such as letters or drawings.

set-dados-artesanales.name: Handcrafted Dice Set
set-dados-artesanales.short: Carved and hand-painted dice with an artisan aesthetic
set-dados-artesanales.customization: You can choose 4 specially designed dice. Tell me your idea or colours. You can choose up to 2 dice with rounded edges.

groschens-madera-50.name: Wooden Groschen
groschens-madera-50.short: 50 wooden groschen, painted one by one
groschens-madera-50.description: 50 wooden coins that emulate the design of Bohemian groschen. Painted and varnished one by one, kept in a raffia bag.

cubilete-artesanal.name: Artisan Dice Cup
cubilete-artesanal.short: Synthetic leather dice cups, hand-cut and hand-stitched
cubilete-artesanal.description: Synthetic leather dice cup, 10 cm tall, ideal for rolling dice. Hand-stitched with an elegant X pattern. Price per unit.

figura-dobby.name: Dobby, from Harry Potter
figura-dobby.description: Resin figure of the elf Dobby, 18 cm tall. Natural colours and matte finish, with highlights in the eyes and the spark of magic.

oleo-minas-tirith.name: "The Citadel" Oil Painting
oleo-minas-tirith.short: An oil-painted interpretation of a great stone citadel among mountains, inspired by medieval fantasy.
oleo-minas-tirith.description: A hand-painted homage to the fantasy landscapes that move me most: a white citadel carved into the rock, under a stormy sky. Oil on canvas, with layered glazes to bring depth to the stone and the mountain.
oleo-minas-tirith.customization: Can be commissioned in other canvas sizes and, if you prefer, with an adapted colour palette or a different landscape.

oleo-rincon-bosque.name: "Forest Corner" Oil Painting
oleo-rincon-bosque.short: A stream tucked away among the trees, oil-painted with plenty of natural light.
oleo-rincon-bosque.description: Painted from one of those forest corners that look straight out of a storybook: water running over stones, light filtering through the leaves and every shade of green. A piece made to bring a little nature to any wall.
oleo-rincon-bosque.customization: Available in several canvas sizes; I can also paint your own reference landscape on request.

retrato-digital-personalizado.name: Custom digital portrait
retrato-digital-personalizado.short: A digital illustration based on your own scene, with a warm style and a touch of humour if you like.
retrato-digital-personalizado.description: Tell me who or what you'd like portrayed — you, your pet, your roleplay character — and I'll turn it into a digital illustration with a semi-realistic or comic-style finish, whichever you're after. This piece, squirrels included, was one of my favourite commissions.
retrato-digital-personalizado.customization: Fully customisable: number of characters, background, style (realistic, comic, chibi) and delivery format (digital file or print).

pack-emotes-personalizados.name: Custom emote pack
pack-emotes-personalizados.short: A set of 3 illustrated emotes, perfect for Discord, Twitch or your favourite chat.
pack-emotes-personalizados.description: A pack of three emotes with a fun, expressive style, made to bring any chat or streaming channel to life. Delivered in high resolution with a transparent background, ready to upload to your platform.
pack-emotes-personalizados.customization: You can choose the expressions, the colours and, if you like, base them on your own character or avatar.

escena-heinrich.name: "Heinrich's Room" scene
escena-heinrich.short: A narrative digital illustration of a medieval interior by the fire.
escena-heinrich.description: A scene meant to tell more than just an image: a boy sitting by the fireplace, in a room full of heraldic details and warmth. Digital illustration with a painterly finish, made for anyone who enjoys stories with depth.
escena-heinrich.customization: I can adapt the scene to your own character, change the point of view, or build a brand new composition on request.

jinete-de-la-niebla.name: "The Rider in the Mist"
jinete-de-la-niebla.short: A digital illustration of a mounted knight, lost in the mist of a pine forest.
jinete-de-la-niebla.description: One of my most atmospheric illustrations: a rider moving through pines and mist, with that cold light I love to paint. A small homage to the aesthetic that inspires me most in medieval fantasy.
jinete-de-la-niebla.customization: Available as a print in different sizes; the original scene is one of a kind, but I can create a similar composition with your own character.

hijos-del-caos.name: "Children of Chaos"
hijos-del-caos.short: A narrative digital illustration of two dark-fantasy characters, an example of a character illustration commission.
hijos-del-caos.description: A commission focused on the relationship between two original characters, with an autumnal palette and a carefully built composition. An example of the kind of narrative scenes I can prepare for your own characters or stories.
hijos-del-caos.customization: Available as a commission with your own characters, colour palette and level of detail to choose from.

luminoso.name: "Luminous"
luminoso.short: A semi-realistic digital illustration of a suit of armour and a white horse, a one-of-a-kind piece.
luminoso.description: A piece made to explore light: the white of the horse, the cold gleam of the armour and a blurred forest background. One of my most personal illustrations, with no commission behind it.

miniatura-caballero-henry.name: Sir Henry
miniatura-caballero-henry.short: Figure of Henry as a knight, hand-painted with nature details.
miniatura-caballero-henry.description: Figure of Henry as a knight, hand-painted with nature details.
miniatura-caballero-henry.customization: I can paint it in the colours you like. If you prefer the brigandine and gambeson in another colour, let me know in the customization box.

diorama-jinete-heraldico.name: Henry on Horseback
diorama-jinete-heraldico.short: Henry mounted on horseback with shield and sword, 23 cm tall.
diorama-jinete-heraldico.description: A piece inspired by the Collector's Edition, showing Henry on a horse. This time I chose to paint it in the colours of Pebbles, my beloved horse from the game. The harness is in Leipa's colours, as is the shield, and Henry brandishes Sir Radzig's sword. With nature details, it is a balanced 23 cm piece, large and perfect for decorating your home.
diorama-jinete-heraldico.customization: I can paint it in the colours you like: the colour of the horse and the harness, as well as Henry's shield and gambeson. Let me know in the customization box.

figura-lune.name: "Lune" Figure
figura-lune.short: Lune figure from Expedition 33 with her elemental effects.
figura-lune.description: Detailed figure of Lune from the video game Expedition 33. Surrounded by her elemental effects, this is a complex but very beautiful piece. 21 cm tall.
figura-lune.customization: Painting service for your own figure (resin or based miniature) with the effects and colours you prefer.

figura-renoir.name: "Renoir" Figure
figura-renoir.short: Renoir figure from Expedition 33, with its paint-stained suit and matte finish.
figura-renoir.description: Renoir figure from the video game Expedition 33 in his classic black suit stained with paint, on fallen petals. 19 cm figure.

diorama-brutus.name: "Brutus", from Julius Caesar
diorama-brutus.short: A small hand-painted architectural diorama, with columns and gold details.
diorama-brutus.description: A piece I designed from Tom McKay's interpretation of the role in "Julius Caesar" at Shakespeare's Globe Theatre in London. The base on which the character of Brutus stands is directly inspired by the stage of this theatre.
diorama-brutus.customization: The colours of this piece cannot be chosen, only the finish.
